body:
FIX ROUND 1 (OPENING) (M-STORE-123, agent 123) — growth-project-mobile#390 @ f55cc61b7fc7da9beea1a183fb579229052454b0

Scope: F3 store-review fixes for the 10-07 build, items (a)-(e). Mobile only; 15 files, +642 / -9 (under the 700 cap). Three commits, one push.

| Item | Finding | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| (a) | B-IOSREV-1 (S-IOSREV-123) | `app.json` iOS `NSCameraUsageDescription`, `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription`, `NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription` with specific purpose text: Share > Save Image and the support-chat camera no longer end the app; passes the ITMS-90683 scan. Native, so it must be in the 10-07 binary. |
| (b) | B-IOSREV-2 (Guideline 1.2) | `CommunityTermsGate` wraps the client Community stack, the coach Community stack and More > Community: guidelines + "There is no tolerance for objectionable content or abusive users..." + **Agree and continue** (per user, `community_terms_agreed:v1:<userId>`) + **Read the Terms of Service** (`/terms`). Create account: "By creating an account, you agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy." with both links. |
| (c) | B-STORECOPY-1 | Trust Center: TLS 1.3 / AES-256 / secure-enclave guarantees replaced with the packet copy (encrypted in transit, Keychain/Keystore token storage, device-cache disclosure). |
| (d) | B-STORECOPY-4 | `PLAY_STORE_READINESS.md` s4 and `docs/PLAY_INTERNAL_TESTING_PACKAGE.md` s5-6 marked superseded, pointing to the 10-07 store packet, known gaps listed. |
| (e) | B-PLAYREV-1 | expo-audio `recordAudioAndroid: false` + `RECORD_AUDIO` blocked. No reachable recording UI: `communityVoiceNotes` defaults false and is set in no eas.json profile; the only recorder is mounted by the `CommunityVoiceComposer` route, registered only with the flag on. |

Tests that fail on main: `src/config/__tests__/storeReviewPermissions.test.js` (new, 9; runs the real expo-audio plugin), `src/components/community/__tests__/CommunityTermsGate.test.tsx` (new, 11), +2 in `trustCenterPolicyLinks.test.tsx`, +1 in `CreateAccountScreen.test.tsx`. R75: no new casts to any/unknown/never, no empty catch (failures go to `logger.warn`). Copy: no first person, no emojis, no exclamation marks.

CI at this head: Typecheck, lint, test SUCCESS (https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37416332741/job/112115649272); CodeQL SUCCESS.

Follow-up Cs (not in this PR): backend `/terms` should carry the same "no tolerance" sentence (S-IOSREV C-4); `TrustCueRow` (unrendered) still says end-to-end/TLS 1.3/AES-256.

READY FOR AUDIT
